description: landing-page-audit: Method: GET. Query param: url=<public https URL>. Fetches the live HTML of any public landing page and measures it: H1 count and length, filler-word hits (platform/solution/seamless/cutting-edge/next-generation/leading), count of verifiable numbers in the first screen, generic CTA text, social proof below the fold, viewport meta, meta description, page weight in KB. Returns a 0-100 score plus a ranked list of what is costing conversions, each tied to the measured value behind it, and three rewrites for the worst headline. Every finding is measured, never guessed. Unpaid requests return HTTP 402 with an x402 challenge.
